notes.title: Dev Log 1 - June/July 2025 Summer Edition
notes.content:
[h1]Welcome![/h1][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45517497/dc697b9597a70191ead8bd9fd553f88999244e77.png"][/img]Today we bring you our first Steam dev log and our special edition summer dev log for Unmasked Truths: Shattered Dreams!  [/p][p]Now, let's jump into what we have been doing behind the scenes and what we have in store for you during August. 👇[/p][hr][/hr][p]During the last couple of months, the entire team has pulled together to tie up loose ends and complete our very first externally playable build in eager anticipation of our planned March 2026 release of arc 1!  We’ve submitted the game to a ratings review board ahead of the public debut of a 15-minute demo, taking place from August 20-24 at [b][url="https://www.gamescom.global/en"]Gamescom[/url][/b] 2025 in Cologne, Germany, where we have reserved a 2-PC space.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45517497/db6d50229e907b9943e9b7dcd1305b0be261c47b.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]At Gamescom, you will be able to:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Experience the opening cutscene,  [/p][/*][*][p]Walk around the campus front garden and café, and  [/p][/*][*][p]Play through fully voiced conversations between characters. [/p][/*][/list][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45517497/37ce945f4a45c4f74cb863d158d0a1af92d26f4e.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45517497/ac08a90ec6fd4b58abf16ecdfaf9c3a36c4b8eea.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45517497/479e5fda392fe07fe8e643951e5dced140079425.jpg"][/img][/carousel][p]
[b]But don’t feel too left out if you can’t attend![/b]

We also plan to make a version of this 15-minute demo available for free to the general public on [b][url="https://superprotein-studios.itch.io/"]itch.io[/url][/b] in [b]late September[/b]! [/p][hr][/hr][p]From updating the script and finishing the final voiceover recording session, to thumb nailing CGs, and height mapping, no stone has been left unturned!… [/p][list][*][p][b]Explore hidden areas…[/b]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45517497/429b47c361d2aa50c7ef594cf214c472b6105372.jpg"][/img][/p][/*][*][p][b]Relax in peaceful gardens[/b]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45517497/3557054d1cba464d222aca8aa3aa9a110f89d608.jpg"][/img][/p][/*][*][p][b]Who turned out the lights!?[/b]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45517497/589d395d3617d6a71d7fce106b56819f9fabdcff.jpg"][/img][/p][/*][*][p][b]That’s better![/b]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45517497/b82cd1de06362ee7c12fefc2f4001d554a192582.jpg"][/img][/p][/*][*][p][b]It’s deeper than it looks[/b]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45517497/7ffc16564335e759d5a4c56bdb2deef97e4af47a.jpg"][/img][/p][/*][*][p][b]We’re still working on optimizations to make the game even more accessible![/b]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45517497/8548211ae9e327ddc4ad013604e258333dfe79ef.jpg"][/img][/p][/*][/list][p]… quite literally, when you consider team members have spent the last couple of weeks reworking every leaf, stone, and collider to ensure that the game is optimized to run as smoothly as possible, and players don’t accidentally fall into the watery void!  [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45517497/f7e1388e6fc2d8e3eb15b84edb9654e50d40b46a.gif"][/img]But those are just some of the day-to-day things that game devs deal with, especially when taking what was originally planned to be a 2D visual novel and fitting it to a 3D explorable world.[/p][list][*][p][b]What better place to whisper secrets than in the library?[/b] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45517497/d61751ad95bb7eee316dc72e30e14ec6f4101dec.jpg"][/img][/p][/*][*][p][b]Height mapping takes a lot of time and energy…[/b]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45517497/2b4ed30cf65ebaff2c9a126db8807f663b01c8a0.jpg"][/img][/p][/*][*][p][b]… especially when working with so much detail![/b] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45517497/12538221baa9ebfd6865c4fe431555944e1c4b6e.jpg"][/img][/p][/*][*][p][b]The entire campus is brimming with details… [/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45517497/d7c0bc9d57e2ec5bd9629c9635e93b0d36cfef42.jpg"][/img][/p][/*][*][p][b]… all to create a decadent experience.[/b] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45517497/24aa2f8a45c8d5586a745d1679f18198b3e782ce.jpg"][/img][/p][/*][*][p][b]We love polygons![/b] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45517497/609bb1fcfe41b1100dabc8fc76bd09655c2f1e1d.jpg"][/img][/p][/*][/list][p]It’s been a long 4 years, but the end is in sight as we see scenes that were once just a bullet point in an outline fleshing out into the world, and becoming real! We can’t wait to share the results of all our hard work with you.  We hope that players will appreciate all the love and care that’s gone into every aspect of the game’s creation!  

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45517497/b8da2ea8f073b3be81691b523d77bc7e39570a1f.gif"][/img][/p][list][*][p][b]Every element is meticulously handcrafted by multiple people cooperating to ensure they both fit characters and build a seamless world.[/b] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45517497/e4adf80f9c2320d110a8604fd1f10dc08e1bf986.jpg"][/img][/p][/*][*][p][b]Every item is arranged with care to create a world that feels real[/b] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45517497/b699f91719555801244537d8359b1ac7cb0cf9eb.jpg"][/img] [/p][/*][*][p][b]We’ve also included more than a few fun easter eggs for players to find[/b] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45517497/4e8f52c13bc1edb4471545dc6273d9ef0803322b.jpg"][/img][/p][/*][*][p][b]We hope you have fun searching for them all! [/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45517497/dc4ef76773f465ed471a2471b0cc5143fe056f8d.jpg"][/img][/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][hr][/hr][p]We’ve also begun to test a series of work streams with the devs on Discord!

During these hangouts, we answer your questions and generally vibe together while working on elements of the game, with our most recent featuring CGs and 3D sculpting!

We’re currently working on organizing a number of different activities, including coloring contests, Steam gift card giveaways, and more!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45517497/55f741b7418685b9ff745c0b3970af8c6eed3f22.jpg"][/img] [i]Be sure to check out our future live streams if you want to see WIPs of art like our new game covers for Unmasked Truths: Shattered Dreams, as well as 3D and other work as they’re created in real-time![/i][b]We can’t wait to meet you! [/b]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45517497/4be433655bfc46d7d4e9aa187aced7722e4d4c08.gif"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][p]
[b]Last but not least, our company, SuperPROTEIN Studios Inc. now has its very own logo![/b]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45517497/f89c1d1d7fe85f0b67c507048287129e5b18c80a.png"][/img]We think it looks super cute, perfect for a game developer working on a murder mystery game!
(Which reminds me… Lee Dae Hyun mentioned something about SuperPROTEIN being his #1 sponsor, didn’t he…?)

If you’d like to send us a message or contact us for anything business related, you can always reach out to us via social or through our [url="https://unmaskedtruthsgame.com/contact-faq/"][b]web contact form[/b][/url].
[/p][hr][/hr][p]In August, we’ll be sharing plenty of highlights from our Gamescom debut, plus updates to our work on CGs and even more areas of the campus, including the Gymnasium, Lecture Hall, and character bedrooms! [/p][p]
Thank you again to all of our loyal devlog readers!

If you haven’t done so already, don’t forget to wishlist the game on Steam, sign up for our [url="https://unmaskedtruthsgame.com/newsletter/"][b]Newsletter[/b][/url], check out our [url="https://linktr.ee/UnmaskedTruths"][b]socials[/b][/url], and join our [url="https://discord.gg/VsQUPuM5uZ"][b]Discord[/b][/url] to never miss an update, be first to learn about opportunities to join the team, participate in events, win prizes, and even playtest the game!

[b][i]~Unmasked Truths Team[/i][/b]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45517497/8f2ae1ec666f5842876cc38501d99679698c746a.png"][/img][/p]
